question:
Choose the part of the sentence that contains an error:

She insisted to accompany me.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "to accompany" is incorrect in this context. The correct verb construction is "insisted on accompanying."
 
• Certain verbs like "insist" are followed by prepositions (e.g., "on") rather than infinitives (e.g., "to").
 
• The corrected sentence should use "on accompanying" to align with standard grammatical rules.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"She insisted on accompanying me."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "me"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 3: "No error"** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but "to accompany" is incorrect.
 
• **Option 4: "She insisted"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
